goal: Prevent fee-bumped transactions from getting an earlier locktime than the original transaction
Eliminates an unnatural on-chain pattern that fingerprints Bitcoin Core and Electrum wallet users
reviewability: Ready for review with no blocking prerequisites
agreement: Strong support with thorough code review and testing across several iterations
Tested and approved after resolving edge cases around stale tips and chain reorgs (molnard, nervana21)
Suggested placing the locktime check inside the anti-fee-sniping conditional (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes a wallet fingerprinting bug during fee bumps but affects under 2% of replacements
The privacy improvement is worthwhile for wallet users but affects only a few hundred transactions a week
